a2-u6-l1#nerusim.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Tomáš, at his desk at home in Košice beside his laptop, holds his phone to his ear, a little hesitant. Right: Emma, curled up on her bed in the dorm room with a book, answers with a smile, glad to talk.

a2-u6-l1#nechces-ist-s-nami.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Emma, at her desk in the dorm room with a big map of Slovakia spread out in front of her, invites someone on a trip, excited. Right: Marek, on the sofa in his flat, his arm still in a plaster cast and a sling, brightens up at the idea.

a2-u6-l1#overim-si-to.picture: In his flat, Marek, his phone wedged between ear and shoulder, flips through the wall calendar with his good hand to check a date; his other arm is in a plaster cast and a sling.

a2-u6-l1#premysli-si-to.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Emma, phone at her ear, smiles patiently. Right: Marek on his sofa, his arm in a plaster cast, scratches his head with his good hand, undecided.

a2-u6-l2#pocujeme-sa.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Tomáš, in a compartment of the InterCity train with hills rushing past the window, presses his phone to his ear and frowns. Right: Emma, in the dorm kitchen, holds a finger in her other ear, straining to hear him.

a2-u6-l2#prerusilo-nas.picture: Split picture. Left: the train has gone into a dark tunnel, and Tomáš stares at his phone: the call is gone. Right: Emma, in the dorm kitchen, takes her phone from her ear and looks at it, puzzled.

a2-u6-l2#to-bude-asi-omyl.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: a hungry man in a tracksuit, on his sofa in front of the TV, phones in his order with a hand on his stomach. Right: Emma, at her dorm desk, listens with raised eyebrows and kindly shakes her head: he's got the wrong number.

a2-u6-l2#volane-cislo-je-nedostupne.picture: Emma, in the dorm kitchen, frowns at her phone as a recorded voice answers instead of Lucia; a bubble shows Lucia's phone lying in her bag, its battery flat and its screen black.

a2-u6-l2#nechaj-mi-odkaz.picture: Split picture. Left: in the university library, Lucia studies with big headphones on while her phone buzzes, unnoticed, on the table beside her books. Right: Emma, at a tram stop, phone to her ear, gets ready to leave a message after the beep.

a2-u6-l3#stazistka.picture: Emma's first morning as an intern at Tomáš's company: in a smart blazer, with a blank badge on a lanyard round her neck, she arrives at the reception, a little nervous; Petra greets her warmly from behind the desk.

a2-u6-l3#recepcia.picture: The reception at the entrance of Tomáš's company: Petra, at her desk with a phone and a computer, greets a visitor with a smile, while Emma, on a second chair beside her, watches and learns.

a2-u6-l3#pri-telefone-emma.picture: At the reception desk the phone rings: Emma, sitting up straight, picks it up and answers for the first time, while Petra, beside her, gives her an encouraging thumbs-up.

a2-u6-l3#mozem-hovorit-s-panom.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: a businessman in a suit, at his own office desk, asks for someone. Right: Emma, at the reception phone, glances over her shoulder at pán Hudák, who sits at his desk in his glass-walled corner office.

a2-u6-l3#moment-prepojim-vas.picture: Emma, the reception phone at her ear, presses a button to put a caller through; through an open office door nearby, the phone on pani Kollárová's desk rings and she reaches for it.

a2-u6-l3#pan-inzinier-pani-inzinierka.picture: In a corridor at Tomáš's company, Petra introduces Emma to pán Hudák and pani Kollárová: pán Hudák shakes Emma's hand formally, and pani Kollárová smiles beside him.

a2-u6-l4#lutujem-prave-ma-poradu.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: a caller, a woman at her own office desk. Right: Emma, at the reception phone, answers apologetically; behind her, through the open door of the meeting room, pán Hudák sits at a table with his colleagues in a meeting.

a2-u6-l4#momentalne-nie-je-v.picture: Emma, on the reception phone, looks over at pán Hudák's glass-walled corner office: his desk is empty, his chair pushed back, and his coat is gone from the stand.

a2-u6-l4#chcete-nechat-odkaz.picture: At the reception desk, Emma holds the phone to her ear with one hand and has a pen ready over a message pad with the other, listening carefully to the caller.

a2-u6-l4#poviem-mu-to.picture: Pán Hudák, back with his briefcase, stops at the reception desk, and Emma hands him a small handwritten message note; he reads it, nodding.

a2-u6-l8#mila-lucia.picture: Emma, at her dorm desk with a map of Slovakia beside her, types a cheerful e-mail on her laptop; a bubble shows Lucia in the university library reading it on her phone, smiling.

a2-u6-l8#navrh.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Emma spreads a big map of Slovakia across the table and traces a route with her finger; Lucia, Tomáš and Marek, his arm in a sling, lean in, excited.

a2-u6-l8#pozdravuj-mareka.picture: Lucia, coat on and a bag of oranges in her hand, heads out of the dorm room to visit her brother; Emma, at her desk, waves after her. A bubble shows Marek on his sofa, his arm in a sling.

a2-u6-l9#vazena-pani-sokolova.picture: Emma, sitting up straight at her dorm desk, writes a careful, formal e-mail on her laptop; a bubble shows pani Sokolová at the small reception desk of her guesthouse in the Tatras, reading it.

a2-u6-l9#ubytovanie.picture: Emma and Lucia, side by side at Emma's dorm desk, look at photos of a chalet-style guesthouse with wooden balconies and mountains behind it on the laptop screen.

a2-u6-l9#volna-izba.picture: At the small reception desk of her guesthouse, pani Sokolová takes one of the last keys off the key rack behind her and holds it up with a smile: there's still a room free.

a2-u6-l9#izba-je-sice-mala.picture: A small bedroom under the sloping roof of the guesthouse: barely room for two pine beds and a little table, but cosy, with a checked quilt, flowers on the windowsill and the mountain peaks outside the window.

a2-u6-l11#esemeska.picture: Emma, on a bench in the sunny university courtyard, types a text message with both thumbs, grinning.

a2-u6-l11#budem-meskat.picture: Emma stands in a crowded tram stuck in traffic, glancing anxiously at her watch while she types a text with one hand.

a2-u6-l11#musim-zrusit-stretnutie.picture: Split picture. Left: Tomáš, a laptop under his arm, about to walk into a meeting at his company, quickly types a text. Right: Emma, waiting at a table in the café near the university, reads it on her phone, and her face falls.

a2-u6-l13#choice-pi-vela-caju.picture: In the dorm room, Lucia sits in bed with a cold, a red nose and a box of tissues on her knees; Emma hands her a big steaming mug of tea.

a2-u6-l13#choice-chod-prec.picture: In the small office kitchen at Tomáš's company, a cat that has wandered in sits on the table, eyeing Emma's open lunch box; Emma, coming back from the coffee machine with a cup, stops in her tracks.

a2-u6-l15#list.picture: At her dorm desk, Emma folds a handwritten letter to her mum and addresses an envelope, a photo of her family propped against the lamp.

a2-u6-l15#balik.picture: In the post office, a long counter with scales and racks of envelopes, Emma heaves a big parcel onto the scales while the clerk, a cheerful grey-haired man, checks the weight. A bubble shows Emma's mum at home in Ireland opening the same parcel, delighted.

a2-u6-l15#znamka.picture: At the post office counter, the cheerful grey-haired clerk tears a stamp off a sheet for Emma, who holds out her letter in its envelope.
